svg.aria-label: Locator map of St Columba's world in Ireland and Scotland: Gartan in Donegal, his birthplace in 521, in the lands of the Cenél Conaill; Derry, Durrow and Kells, his great monasteries in Ireland, with the Book of Durrow and the Book of Kells; the island of Iona off the Isle of Mull, his home from 563 to 597, in the kingdom of Dál Riata with its fortress at Dunadd; and, in the land of the Picts, the court of King Bridei near Inverness, at Craig Phadrig, with Loch Ness and the River Ness. An inset shows the area within Britain and Ireland.
